description:
intent=i024 snapshot=s03 branch=header-accessor-no-linearize status=complete
finding location=net/ncsi/ncsi-rsp.c:1185-1229 confidence=medium conclusion=NCSI packet_type handler ncsi_rcv_rsp() dereferences skb_network_header()-derived ncsi_pkt_hdr fields (type/id/length at ncsi-rsp.c:1185-1229) with no pskb_may_pull anywhere in net/ncsi, so a crafted non-linear 0x88F8 frame reads past skb_headlen into frags/stale head (OOB read, crash-prone).
finding location=net/ncsi/ncsi-aen.c:216-243 confidence=medium conclusion=ncsi_aen_handler() dereferences skb_network_header()-derived aen header fields and a payload-relative checksum pointer (ncsi-aen.c:216-243) with no linearization check, so a non-linear NCSI AEN frame reads beyond the skb linear area.
unresolved location=net/ieee802154/6lowpan/rx.c:97 conclusion=Follow up: trace ieee802154 RX into lowpan_rx_h_dispatch/lowpan_frag_rcv to confirm whether skb_network_header(skb)[0] is guaranteed inside the linear head for every non-linear (fraglist) skb reaching net/ieee802154/6lowpan/rx.c.
unresolved location=net/mac802154/llsec.c:631 conclusion=Follow up: audit mac802154 ieee802154_rcv/llsec path to verify skb_mac_header(skb)..+frame_len always lies in the linear head (i.e. frames are never non-linear) before llsec scatter-list reads in net/mac802154/llsec.c.
unresolved location=drivers/net/mctp/mctp-i2c.c:499 conclusion=Follow up: read the mctp-i2c/i3c RX skb allocation to confirm the driver-built skb is always fully linear before the skb_mac_header() casts at drivers/net/mctp/mctp-i2c.c:499 and mctp-i3c.c:375.
unresolved location=drivers/net/ppp/pppoe.c:1219 conclusion=Follow up: verify whether a non-linear skb can reach pppoe_disc_rcv/pppoe_rcv with the 6-byte PPPoE header outside the linear head before the skb_network_header() casts at drivers/net/ppp/pppoe.c:1219-1239.
unresolved location=net/dsa/tag_sja1105.c:105 conclusion=Follow up: trace sja1105_rcv into sja1105_meta_unpack to check whether a GRO-merged non-linear meta frame can present its 8 payload bytes outside the linear head at net/dsa/tag_sja1105.c:105.
coverage_gap=Only net/ and drivers/net/ .c files were scanned; the 145/82 per-file accessor hits were triaged by filename and receive-path heuristics, and ~230 files with 1-2 accessor uses (mostly TX checksum/GSO paths in ethernet drivers) were never opened.
coverage_gap=net/ipv6/exthdrs.c, net/ipv6/ndisc.c, net/ipv6/mcast.c, net/xfrm/xfrm_iptfs.c, net/openvswitch/flow.c and net/core/drop_monitor.c have many accessor dereferences but were only name-triaged; the OVS flow-key extractor in particular walks variable-length headers and was not read.
coverage_gap=The five unresolved candidates (6lowpan rx, mac802154 llsec, mctp i2c/i3c, pppoe, sja1105 tagger) were classified from accessor lines plus one-line context only; their enclosing receive functions and skb allocation/linearization provenance were not read.
limitation=Both findings are source-reading hypotheses, not reproductions: no KASAN build, crafted non-linear NCSI frame, or running NCSI device was used; unlike the phonet seed, the concrete failure is an OOB read past skb_headlen (or stale-head read after GRO realloc) rather than a KASAN-confirmed slab-use-after-free.
limitation=Exploitability of the NCSI findings depends on a driver that hands a non-linear skb for protocol 0x88F8 into __netif_receive_skb_core (scatter-gather/GRO RX with the NCSI ethertype); the survey of NCSI-capable drivers for this property was not done, so remote reachability is plausible but unproven.
limitation=The scan detected accessor lines but did not perform dataflow analysis, so a dereference reachable through a helper function or a macro-wrapped accessor (e.g. ipv6_hdr(), tcp_hdr(), ip_hdr() wrappers) could have been missed; those wrappers were outside this branch's literal grep terms.
